data._TIPS:
请按照如下步骤设置:
1 购买9999个鹤嘴锄并保存在仓库里
2 六人队伍脱掉所有装备, 然后尽可能多的携带鹤嘴锄
3 在王城的工会里新建一个队伍, 并命名为FFXIStone.
4 前往活动地图2F, 在哈肯正对的矿点前, 打上标记.
5 确保这是该层唯一的标记.
6 副本或主城中启动脚本.

Please follow these steps to set it up:
1 Purchase 9,999 pickaxes.
2 Have your six-person party remove all equipment, then carry as many pickaxes as possible.
3 Create a new party at the Guild in the Royal City and name it "FFXIStone".
4 Go to the 2nd floor and place a marker at the mining place directly facing Harken.
5 Ensure this is the only marker on that floor.
6 Start the script while in the dungeon or the city.

items.value:
请按照如下步骤设置:
1 购买9999个鹤嘴锄并保存在仓库里
2 六人队伍脱掉所有装备, 然后尽可能多的携带鹤嘴锄
3 在王城的工会里新建一个队伍, 并命名为FFXIStone.
4 前往活动地图2F, 在哈肯正对的矿点前, 打上标记.
5 确保这是该层唯一的标记.
6 副本或主城中启动脚本.

Please follow these steps to set it up:
1 Purchase 9,999 pickaxes.
2 Have your six-person party remove all equipment, then carry as many pickaxes as possible.
3 Create a new party at the Guild in the Royal City and name it "FFXIStone".
4 Go to the 2nd floor and place a marker at the mining place directly facing Harken.
5 Ensure this is the only marker on that floor.
6 Start the script while in the dungeon or the city.
